records.note: No data found on where trans prisoners are housed in Southeast Sulawesi: no placement rule, no trans-specific custody unit, and no documented in-prison housing/segregation case for a transgender inmate in this province were located within the search budget (one English-Wikipedia full-text search on transgender prisoner housing in Indonesia; candidate fetches: en-Wikipedia 'LGBTQ rights in Indonesia' and id-Wikipedia 'Waria'; a Reuters candidate on transgender inmates in Indonesian prisons was blocked by a 401 captcha and was not re-attempted). The fetched Wikipedia material contains no prison-placement content for this province: the en-Wikipedia article's only prison-adjacent claims are 2001-era reporting that gay inmates in Indonesian jails are often abused and fear re-incarceration, Jakarta Social Agency raids that detain transgender women outside prison, and a 2022 report of a waria murdered in South Sulawesi (not in custody) - none of it a placement finding. It is unknown whether trans prisoners here are held in male or female blocks; no published rule or case was verified either way, so no placement claim can be stated.

No data found on where trans prisoners are housed in Yogyakarta: no placement rule, no trans-specific custody unit, and no documented housing/segregation case for a transgender inmate in this special region were located within the search budget (one English-Wikipedia full-text search on transgender prisoner housing in Indonesia/waria cells; candidate fetches: en-Wikipedia 'LGBTQ rights in Indonesia' and id-Wikipedia 'Waria'; a Reuters candidate on transgender inmates was blocked by a 401 captcha and not re-attempted). Nothing in the fetched material mentions Yogyakarta's prison system (no Lapas/Rutan placement record for the region was found). The only verified national context is that transgender visibility is met with criminalisation-adjacent enforcement in parts of Indonesia (detention during Jakarta Social Agency raids; moral-police 'offence' statements with jail threats) - none located for Yogyakarta - and the article's jail-abuse claim is 2001-era and not placement-specific. Unknown, not verified: whether trans prisoners here are held in male or female blocks; no placement finding can be stated.
